sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Removes resurrection, wards, invincibility, damage reflection, continuous healing, and damage reduction effects.
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 250. Success value 100. 4x physical damage (Dark).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Removes buffs.
-Target: all allies. Reduces physical/magic damage taken to 0 (7 times). Effect applied for 40 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Cost recovery speed by 10 for 90 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Twilight for 90 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; heals for 10% of damage dealt; boosts Break increase value by 40; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. When in effect and an enemy is defeated, recovers 30% of your max HP; fills Unison gauge by 20; and debuffs/special debuffs are removed).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 12000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 12000

[Merciful Pure-White Devil] Albedo or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
